cmd:
set -e; D=/opt/trading-bot/genetic; mkdir -p $D; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo; git show origin/main:bot/genetic/genetic.py > $D/genetic.py; git show origin/main:bot/genetic/index.html > $D/index.html; chown -R tbot:tbot $D; /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/genetic.py; printf "[Unit]
Description=Genetic search page
After=network.target
[Service]
User=tbot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 18096 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory /opt/trading-bot/genetic
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
" > /etc/systemd/system/genetic-panel.service; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now genetic-panel; su -s /bin/sh tbot -c "cd $D && GEN_POP=200 GEN_GENS=40 GEN_NOISE=3 GEN_WORKERS=2 nohup nice -n 19 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python genetic.py > run.log 2>&1 &"; sleep 20; tail -5 $D/run.log; systemctl is-active genetic-panel; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}
" localhost:18096/index.html
